dimensions.reasons: The scene clearly realizes a retro-industrial kinetic-typography machine: the wooden workbench, large title display, brass gear panel, cam-and-spring panel, conveyor-like front carriage, two articulated arms, and staged MOMENTUM letters are all visible. Group B's momentum_0001 through momentum_0160 show progressively more letters being placed, ending with the completed title in preview_200_v2 and cycles_test_200.
issues: The direct Group C video-frame sequence is visually static across frame_0001 through frame_0016, so the submitted MP4 does not visibly demonstrate the requested synchronized mechanical sequence.
The displayed gear train, cam panel, and arms look like separately presented modules rather than a clearly traceable, continuously connected drive chain.
The mechanism is somewhat visually crowded during assembly, with the carriage and arms obscuring letters and lower linkage areas.

dimensions.reasons: The major structure is convincingly supported: the tabletop has four substantial legs and foot pads, the rail frame and panels have thickness and visible fasteners, and the arm links terminate in plausible circular pivots. In Group A detail_arms and the Group B stage images, letters rest on the carriage or are visibly contained by the U-shaped grippers rather than floating.
issues: The functional attachment between the decorative gear/cam panels and the working arm pivots is not visually clear.
The foreground carriage and letter blanks are dense enough that a few contact relationships are difficult to inspect.

dimensions.reasons: The object silhouettes read clearly as toothed gears, cams, springs, rods, articulated arms, extruded letters, rails, and an industrial bench. The warm brass/copper coloration, darker steel framework, cream bold sans-serif letters, and wood trim consistently establish the requested retro-industrial style, particularly in Group A detail_gears and Group B cycles_test_200.
issues: The palette is heavily orange/copper overall, so the intended cool-grey steel is less distinct than it could be.
The small gray feed-side block remains an ambiguous box-like module rather than a recognizable feeder device.
Some letter and arm contours lose definition in strong bloom or motion blur, such as the arm in momentum_0160.

dimensions.reasons: The designated author renders, especially cycles_test_200 and preview_200_v2, are clean and coherent, with convincing depth, detailed rivets, readable layered construction, and no major rendering artifacts. The warm workshop setting and blurred industrial-looking background support the miniature-machine presentation.
issues: The result reads more as a polished stylized product diorama than as a worn working industrial machine.
Bloom, shallow depth of field, and the uniformly polished finish soften fine mechanical detail.
There is limited visible grime, oil residue, wear variation, or complex functional hardware around the moving mechanisms.

dimensions.reasons: The spatial organization is strong: the title-card rail occupies the center, the gear and cam modules sit above it, the two arms work in front of it, and the feed/carriage zone runs along the front. Group B momentum_0001, momentum_0041, momentum_0081, and momentum_0120 provide readable staged placements from loose foreground blanks to letters on the back display.
issues: The arms, front rail, and title letters overlap substantially in several assembly views, reducing the requested separability for teaching.
The gear panel and cam panel are visually elevated above the action but their mechanical routing into the arms is not spatially legible.
The final title is presented as a locked rail display, but the lower rail still partially blocks the bottoms of the letters.

dimensions.reasons: The scale relationships are internally convincing: the large main gear dominates its smaller driven gears, the letters have a substantial title-card presence, the two arms have enough reach to span the carriage and display, and the bench reads as a wide, heavy industrial workstation. The labeled 400 mm main pitch diameter further supports the intended scale in Group A detail_gears.
issues: Exact requested dimensions such as the 4 m by 1.4 m bench, 2 m conveyor, 0.5 m letter height, and 0.15 m extrusion cannot be independently verified from the renders.
The tall plain backdrop is visually oversized compared with the compact tabletop mechanism in the wide evaluator views.

dimensions.reasons: The author-final images use an effective warm key, cooler edge light, soft ambient fill, and workshop-like blurred background. Brass/copper parts have weathered speckled oxidation on the gears, steel links have visible highlights, and the wood fascia has readable grain; cycles_test_200 gives the clearest material evidence.
issues: The wood is notably glossy and saturated rather than matte.
The intense warm lighting and bloom compress material separation between brass, copper, and wood.
Steel is present but does not consistently read as cool-grey clear-coated metal because many parts inherit warm reflections.

dimensions.reasons: Most requested static elements are present in approximately the required count: a multi-size gear train, two cam/spring assemblies and rods, a long front feed/carriage, two articulated pickup arms, eight extruded letters, rails, rivets, indicator labels, and a wooden industrial bench. Group B preview_200_v2 and cycles_test_200 visibly complete the MOMENTUM title card.
issues: The sampled Group C exported-video frames show no detectable progress across frame_0001 to frame_0016, so the requested animation, timing synchronization, camera push/orbit, and finished motion sequence are not substantiated by the actual video evidence.
The gear-to-cam-to-arm mechanical linkage is not visibly complete as a functional drive chain.
The conveyor is represented by a front rail/carriage, but it does not clearly read as a distinct 2 m conveyor mechanism.

criteria.criterion: The complete machine choreography must assemble and lock MOMENTUM through a synchronized, unobstructed, pedagogically readable sequence.
The complete gear train must satisfy the stated dimensions, common-module compatibility, connected engagement, and mechanically compatible operation.
Two identifiable camshafts must each produce recurring push-rod reciprocation.
The conveyor must have the stated transport length and visibly feed letter blanks into the handling workflow.
Two three-joint robotic arms must both perform letter pick-and-place.
All eight title letters must share the specified bold sans-serif form and dimensions.
The supporting bench must satisfy its dimensions, base role, construction detailing, and complete dark matte wood finish.
The machine must achieve the requested retro-industrial kinetic-typography identity through a coherent old mechanism and its complete brass-and-steel surface system.
criteria.evidence: The rendered machine reads as one cohesive retro-industrial typographic assembly: mottled orange-brass/copper gears, pivots, rods, and fittings are visibly aged and oxidized, while the arm links, rails, shafts, fasteners, and base trim use separately readable cool-grey reflective metal. The metal highlights and the clearly different wood fascia/frame are especially visible in cycles_test_200 and detail_gears.

criteria.criterion: The native lighting setup and authored result must jointly provide the requested warm key, cool rim, ambient fill, and interior HDRI.
The authored shot must use the requested ordered movement, focal length, and readable shallow-focus treatment.
The delivered Blender project must be openable, editable, complete, and preserve the requested native Cycles rendering configuration and motion-blur result.
The actual PNG sequence and composited MP4 must form a complete, openable output package with the required resolution and timing.

notes: A strong, highly recognizable static retro-industrial MOMENTUM assembly machine with good modeled detail, staging, and lighting. The principal weakness is motion evidence: staged Group B images imply letter placement, but the actual sampled exported video frames appear frozen, and the full synchronized drive chain remains more illustrative than mechanically legible.
score_policy: Frozen paper score: uncapped 0.5 rubric + 0.5 dimension.
